column9: Review-worthy remote curriculum/product design leadership role. Strong alignment with curriculum design, adult learning, professional learning, stakeholder collaboration, product iteration, and K-12 educator credibility. Main cautions: salary range $91K-$124K is near/below target, role asks for deep K-8 ELA pedagogy and multilingual learner/ELD content expertise, and includes product marketing/sales collaboration. Recommend review, not automatic apply.
